server.name: ais
server.title: Agentic Intelligence System
server.description: Discovery, capability routing and workspace legibility. Answers what a repository can do, which capability a request routes to, and what the citation is. It does not execute the work and does not store memory.
boundary: Read-only over a workspace. No writes except receipts under .ais/receipts/.
Never returns the content of a denylisted file, and never returns an absolute machine path.
Refuses rather than guesses: an unrouted request comes back refused with a rationale.

tools.name: ais_scan_repository
tools.description: Scan a repository path and return a sanitized RepositoryProfile with the capabilities and evidence it can justify. Denylisted files are counted, never opened.

repoPath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the repository root.

owner.description: Who owns the resulting profile nodes.

tools.name: ais_route_request
tools.description: Resolve an AgentRequest to a Capability through the Route and Policy graph. Returns a Resolution; status is resolved only when a citation could be attached.

intent.description: What the caller is trying to do, in their own words.

requester.description: Which agent or person is asking.

tools.name: ais_write_receipt
tools.description: Persist a request and its resolution as an evaluable receipt under .ais/receipts/. A receipt counts as an activation only when the resolution is resolved and carries at least one citation.

tools.name: ais_check_registry_drift
tools.description: Compare scanned capabilities against the private AI Capability Registry export. Reports drift; never republishes registry content. Returns status "unavailable" when the registry path is not supplied — absence is never a pass.

registryPath.description: Path to a local ai-capability-registry checkout, or directly to exports/capabilities.json.
